generated_from: local Git object database verified against documented GitHub heads
digest_contract: SHA-256 of UTF-8 compact JSON.stringify over keys in this exact order: schema_version, pr, pr_base_sha, merge_base_sha, head_sha, archive_ref, unique_commits, changed_files. changed_files entries always use key order status, old_path, path and are sorted by path, old_path, status using Node localeCompare(en). unique_commits use git rev-list --reverse --topo-order <merge_base>..<head>.
closure_rule: A PR may be closed only after its archive_ref resolves to head_sha and this receipt is merged on main. Source branches are not deleted by this operation.
